data.name: CatalogMismatch
data.value: Local model catalog mismatch: client '{0}', broker '{1}'.

data.name: DurationSeconds
data.comment: The number arrives already formatted invariantly.

data.name: DurationWithQueue
data.comment: Only when the wait is a real share of the total; the ordinary line stays short.

data.name: EmptyLog
data.value: The supplied log is empty; no failure is present.
data.comment: Not an error: this is the answer triage_log returns for an empty log.

data.name: ExactlyOneSource
data.value: Provide exactly one of path or text.
data.comment: path and text are parameter names and stay Latin.

data.name: FilesProcessed
data.comment: 2 is the ellipsis when more files were named than are listed.

data.name: ImageProfileUnsupported
data.value: Image tasks support VisualAnalysis, Ocr, or ImageTranslation.
data.comment: Profile names are identifiers and are never translated.

data.name: ImagesTooLargeTogether
data.value: The images together exceed the {0}MB total limit for one call; split the request.

data.name: ImagesTooManyPixels
data.value: The images together exceed the {0:N0}-pixel total limit for one call; split the request.
data.comment: N0 formats invariantly in both languages, by the rule the notice line follows.

data.name: Ineligible
data.value: A local model for {0} is installed, but none can take this request. Ask for a smaller context, or — for an image — a smaller one: each model declares the context sizes and the pixel count it accepts.

data.name: IneligibleWithModels
data.value: A local model for {0} is installed, but none can take this request. The models for it are {1}. Ask for a smaller context, or — for an image — a smaller one: each model declares the context sizes and the pixel count it accepts.

data.name: InputTruncated
data.value: ; input truncated at the shared {0}-character budget

data.name: LogTextRead
data.value: Log text read: {0} characters, fragments: {1}, context: {2}

data.name: LogTriageNoReceipt
data.value: Log triage produced no model receipt.

data.name: ModelNotConfiguredForTriage
data.value: Model '{0}' is not configured for log triage.

data.name: NoModelAndCatalogNamesNone
data.value: No local model able to do {0} is installed, and the routing catalog names none for it. Run local_models_status to see what is installed.

data.name: NoModelInstalled
data.value: No local model able to do {0} is installed. This task runs on {1}.

data.name: NoModelInstalledWithInstall
data.value: No local model able to do {0} is installed. This task runs on {1}. Install one through the broker: localai-launcher.exe run localai model pull --model {2} --catalog-version {3}
data.comment: No full stop after the command in either language: a trailing period gets copied into a shell.

data.name: NoTriageModel
data.value: No full-VRAM log-triage model/context is available. Tried: {0}.

data.name: NoTriageModelNoneTried
data.value: No full-VRAM log-triage model/context is available. Tried: none.

data.name: NotATextChatProfile
data.value: Task profile '{0}' is not a text-chat profile.

data.name: NotAnImage
data.value: '{0}' does not look like an image.

data.name: Notice
data.comment: 0 model, 1 residency mark or empty, 2 detail, 3 duration, 4 saving sentence.

data.name: QuestionDoesNotFitContext
data.value: The question and configured prompt overhead do not fit the selected context.

data.name: ResidencyAdvice
data.value: ⚠️ This machine's policy allows models to load below full video-memory residency. To require full residency again: localai policy set --residency RequireFullVram — the broker applies it after a restart.
data.comment: Said once per process. The command is never translated.

data.name: ResidencyCpu
data.value: (entirely on the CPU — answers are much slower)

data.name: ResidencyPartialOffload
data.value: ({0}% of the model in VRAM — answers are slower)
data.comment: Beside the model name, so a reader who stops after the first clause has seen it.

data.name: SavedAbout
data.comment: 0 is already a range such as ~15–18K.

data.name: SavedNegligible
data.value: Saved a negligible number of cloud tokens — under ~0.5K.

data.name: SavedNothing
data.value: Saved no cloud tokens: the answer is no shorter than the input.
data.comment: Zero is a correct answer, not a broken counter, so the sentence says why.

data.name: SavingUnderHalfK
data.comment: The band on its own, for a caller composing its own sentence.

data.name: TooManyFiles
data.value: {0} files exceed the {1}-file limit for one call; split the request.

data.name: TooManyImages
data.value: {0} images exceed the {1}-image limit for one call; split the request.
data.comment: The Russian puts the count after a colon so the numeral does not have to agree.

data.name: TranslationNotice
data.value: 🔧 Local: {0}{1}. Translation checked: {2}. {3}. Processed locally: {4} tokens; cloud generation saved: {5}; net cloud context reduced by {6}.

data.name: TranslationValidationFailed
data.value: Local translation failed structural validation after fallback: {0}.

data.name: UnknownValue
data.comment: 0 is a parameter identifier and stays Latin in both languages.

data.name: ValidatorEmptyTranslation
data.comment: Validator details are lowercase: they only ever appear after a colon inside another sentence.
